parsed.doc_summary: SF Rent Board overview of just cause eviction protections under the SF Rent Ordinance §37.9(a): 17 just cause grounds, housing services protection, and coverage of units exempt from rent increase limits.

rules.title: SF Rent Ordinance just cause eviction (Section 37.9(a))
rules.requirement: A landlord of a unit covered by the Rent Ordinance may evict only for one of 17 listed just causes, which must be the dominant motive. Expiration of a lease or a change in ownership is not just cause; removing housing services also needs just cause.
rules.quoted_span: In order to evict a tenant from a rental unit covered by the Rent Ordinance, a landlord must have a "just cause" reason that is the dominant motive for pursuing the eviction.
rules.key_value: 17 just cause reasons; dominant motive required
rules.exemptions: Some tenancies regulated by other government agencies may be exempt in part; units exempt from rent increase limits (post-June 13, 1979 CO, Costa-Hawkins) still covered by eviction provisions.

unverifiable_exemptions: some tenancies where the rent is regulated by another government agency

rules.coverage_conditions: Rental units covered by the SF Rent Ordinance, including units exempt from rent increase limits such as post-1979 construction.
rules.penalty: Substantial civil and/or criminal liability for unlawful or attempted eviction.
rules.effective_date_note: Effective date not stated in document.

rules.title: SF Rent Ordinance rent increase limits: coverage note
rules.requirement: Newly constructed units with a first Certificate of Occupancy after June 13, 1979, and Costa-Hawkins-eligible tenancies are exempt from the Ordinance's rent increase limits, but remain subject to its just cause eviction rules.
rules.quoted_span: This includes tenancies in newly constructed rental units that first obtained a Certificate of Occupancy after June 13, 1979, tenancies that are eligible for a rent increase under the
rules.key_value: CO after 1979-06-13 exempt from rent increase limits
rules.exemptions: Units with first CO after June 13, 1979; Costa-Hawkins-eligible tenancies; some tenancies regulated by another government agency.

unverifiable_exemptions: tenancies regulated by another government agency

rules.coverage_conditions: Only coverage facts stated; rent cap formula not in this document.
